title: Seedance 2.0 reference-to-video: wire the reference images, videos and audio
description: seedance-2-cloud sends only first_frame_image, so its i2v puts the picture in as frame one of the clip. DeepInfra's ByteDance/Seedance-2.0 in_schema also takes reference_images (up to 9), reference_videos (up to 3), reference_audios (up to 3) and last_frame_image. Add a reference op (identity, location, prop, motion and voice references each with a named job) and a first+last-frame op. The references are URLs or asset:// ids, never uploads, so the real question is hosting: find whether DeepInfra offers an asset upload, else how the app serves a staged file to the provider. The recipe's i2v mode already writes the @Image/@Video tag shape this op would feed; until it ships, that shape names inputs the app never sends (MPI-903 records the routing fact). Found 2026-09-24: a character sheet was about to go in as a Seedance first frame.
